1.1: Horu vet din laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, vehalach hayyachid veasa shogeg al pihem, ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa, patur, mippene shettala vevet din. horu vet din veyada echad mehen shettau, o talmid vehu rauy lehoraa, vehalach veasa al pihen, ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa, hare ze chayyav, mippene shello tala bevet din. ze hakkelal, hattole veatzmo, chayyav. vehattole bevet din, patur:
1.2: Horu vet din, veyadu shettau, vechazru vahen, ben sheheviu chapparatan uven shello heviu chapparatan, vehalach veasa al pihen, rabbi shimon poter, verabbi eliezer omer, safek. ezehu safek. yashav lo vetoch beto, chayyav. halach lo limdinat hayyam, patur. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani vaze shehu karov liftur min hachova. amar lo ven azzay, ma shana ze min hayyoshev beveto, shehayyoshev beveto efshar haya lo sheyyishma, veze lo haya efshar lo sheyyishma:
1.3: Horu vet din laakor et kol hagguf, amru, en nidda vattora, en shabbat battora, en avoda zara vattora, hare ellu feturin. horu levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat, hare ellu chayyavin. ketzad. amru, yesh nidda vattora, aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur. yesh shabbat battora, aval hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, patur. yesh avoda zara vattora, aval hammishtachave fatur, hare ellu chayyavin, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) venelam davar, davar velo chol hagguf:
1.4: Horu vet din, veyada echad mehen shettau, veamar lahen toin attem, o shello haya mufla shel bet din sham, o shehaya achad mehen ger o mamzer o natin o zaken shello raa lo vanim, hare ellu feturin, shenneemar kan eda (Vayikra 4) veneemar lehallan (Bamidbar la) eda, ma eda haamur lehallan ad sheyyihyu chullam reuyin lehoraa, af eda haamura chan ad sheyyihyu chullam reuyim lehoraa. horu vet din shoggim veasu chol hakkahal shoggin, meviin par. mezidin veasu shoggin, meviin kisba useira. shoggin veasu mezidin, hare ellu feturin:
1.5: Horu vet din, veasu chol hakkahal o rubban al pihem, meviin par. uvaavoda zara, meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shenem asar shevatim meviin shenem asar parim, uvaavoda zara, meviin shenem asar parim ushenem asar seirim. rabbi shimon omer, shelosha asar parim, uvaavoda zara, shelosha asar parim ushelosha asar seirim, par vesair lechol shevet vashevet, par vesair levet din. horu vet din, veasu shiva shevatim o rubban al pihem, meviim par, uvaavoda zara meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shiva shevatim shechatu, meviim shiva farim, ushear shevatim shello chatu, meviin al yedehen par, sheaf ellu shello chatu, meviin al yede hachotim. rabbi shimon omer, shemona farim. uvaavoda zara, shemona farim ushemona seirim, par vesair lechol shevet vashevet, ufar vesair levet din. horu vet din shel echad min hashshevatim veasa oto hashshevet al pihem, oto hashshevet hu chayyav, ushear kol hashshevatim peturim, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavim ella al horayat bet din haggadol bilvad, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) veim kol adat yisrael yishgu, velo adat oto hashshevet:

2.1: Hora chohen mashiach leatzmo, shogeg veasa shogeg, mevi far. shogeg veasa mezid, mezid veasa shogeg, patur, shehoraat kohen mashiach leatzmo, chehoraat bet din latztzibbur:
2.2: Hora vifne atzmo veasa vifne atzmo, mitkapper lo vifne atzmo. hora im hatztzibbur veasa im hatztzibbur, mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur, sheen bet din chayyavim ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat, vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat:
2.3: En chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase, vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, en chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase. en bet din chayyavin ad sheyyoru vedavar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat. vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, ad sheyyoru al davar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat:
2.4: En chayyavin al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash, veen meviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash. aval chayyavin al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda, umeviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda. ezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda, perosh min hannidda. umitzvat lo taase, lo tavo el hannidda:
2.5: En chayyavin al shemiat hakkol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumat mikdash vekadashav. vehannasi kayyotze vahem, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, hannasi chayyav bechullan chutz mishshemiat hakkol, shehammelech lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto:
2.6: Kol hammitzvot shebbattora shechayyavin al zedonan karet veal shiggatan chattat, hayyachid mevi chisba useira, vehannasi sair, umashiach uvet din meviin par. uvaavoda zara, hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach meviin seira, uvet din par vesair, par leola vesair lechattat:
2.7: Asham taluy, hayyachid vehannasi chayyavin, umashiach uvet din peturim. asham vadday, hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyavin, uvet din peturin. al shemiat hakkol veal bittuy sefatayim veal tumat mikdash vekadashav, bet din peturin, vehayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyavin, ella sheen kohen gadol chayyav al tumat mikdash vekadashav, divre rabbi shimon. uma hen meviin, karban ole veyored. rabbi eliezer omer, hannasi mevi sair:

3.1: Kohen mashiach shechata veachar kach avar mimmeshichuto, vechen nasi shechata veachar kach avar miggedullato, kohen mashiach mevi far, vehannasi mevi sair:
3.2: Kohen mashiach sheavar mimmeshichuto veachar kach chata, vechen hannasi sheavar miggedullato veachar kach chata, kohen mashiach mevi far, vehannasi chehedyot:
3.3: Chatu ad shello nitmannu veachar kach nitmannu, hare ellu chehedyot. rabbi shimon omer, im noda lahem ad shello nitmannu, chayyavin. umishshennitmannu, peturin. veezehu hannasi, ze hammelech, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav, nasi sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav:
3.4: Veezehu hammashiach, hammashuach beshemen hammishcha, lo hamerubbe vivgadim. en ben kohen hammashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella far habba al kol hammitzvot. veen ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar, ella far yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa. ze vaze shavin baavodat yom hakkippurim, umetzuvvin al habbetula, vaasurin al haalmana, veenan mittammein bikrovehen, velo forin, velo formin, umachazirin et harotzeach:
3.5: Kohen gadol porem millematta, vehahedyot milmala. kohen gadol makriv onen velo ochel, vehahedyot lo makriv velo ochel:
3.6: Kol hattadir mechavero, kodem et chavero. vechol hamekuddash mechavero, kodem et chavero. par hammashiach ufar haeda omdim, par hammashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav:
3.7: Haish kodem laishsha lehachayot ulehashiv aveda. vehaishsha kodemet laish lichsut, ulehotziah mibbet hashshevi. bizman sheshshenehem omdim lekalkala, haish kodem laishsha:
3.8: Kohen kodem lelevi, levi leyisrael, yisrael lemamzer, umamzer lenatin, venatin leger, veger leeved meshuchrar. ematay, bizman shekkullan shavin. aval im haya mamzer talmid chacham vechohen gadol am haaretz, mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz:
